title: Restricting a rectifiable triple to an open set
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, U′, V, M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^P → Λₙ(ℝ^P), and assume IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ (the triple conditions of Simon Ch. 6, 3.1 relative to U, with Hⁿ = μHE[n] and orientation by weighted approximate tangent spaces of (M, θ)). Suppose V is open, M ∩ V ⊆ U′, and θ is Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ V ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U′. Then IsRectifiableTriple U′ n (M ∩ V) θ ξ: the restricted triple (M ∩ V, θ, ξ) satisfies all triple conditions relative to U′, including the orientation condition with respect to the weighted approximate tangent spaces of (M ∩ V, θ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U U' V M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → IsOpen V → M ∩ V ⊆ U' → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U' → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ V ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → IsRectifiableTriple U' n (M ∩ V) θ ξ
